title: Same-tick draw + demolish apply in lower_intents append order (draws first), not demo file order
detail: All draws append before all demolishes; the per-tick batch preserves action_log order, so a same-tick draw+demolish applies in append order, not file order. Deterministic (live==replay). A same-tick `demolish node X` + `draw X _` diverges from author intent: file order latches replay_error (.Missing_Node), append order succeeds.
recommended_fix: Stably sort state.action_log by apply_tick after lower_intents (file-order tie-break), or document that same-tick draws always precede same-tick demolishes.
